newsitem.title: ITALY: Popolare Milano details merger share swap.
newsitem.headline: Popolare Milano details merger share swap.

text.p: Banca Popolare di Milano detailed the intended share swap ratio for its incorporation of Banca Agricola Milanese and Banca Briantea Spa.
It said in a statement boards of the respective banks agreed a ratio of seven Banca Agricola Milanese shares for every 10 Popolare Milano shares.
They also agreed seven Briantea shares for every 10 Popolare Milano shares.
The Bank of Italy has given its approval to the merger project between the bank and its two subsidiaries and the plan now has to be approved by extraordinary shareholders' meetings.
Popolare Milano intends to call the extraordinary meeting in September.
Trading in the bank's shares was suspended on the Milan stock market on Monday and Tuesday pending an announcement.
